title: Cheesy Warming Pasta Bake
description: A comforting and satisfying vegan pasta dish, perfect for a chilly evening. The rigatoni is baked with a creamy and tangy cheesy sauce.

ingredients.name: Plant-based cheese shreds
ingredients.notes: such as Daiya or Follow Your Heart

ingredients.name: Warming spice mix
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, paprika, and turmeric

instructions: Cook the rigatoni pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt the vegan butter or margarine over medium heat.
Add the warming spice mix and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the plant-based cheese shreds and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked rigatoni pasta to the saucepan and toss to coat with the cheesy sauce.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped fresh parsley.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with nutritional yeast (if using).
